description:
Advances from a small village to a bustling town, ready to expand rapidly. This is the Persian town phase.  The 'Times of War' bonus decreases the batch training time in Stables. Large batches will benefit more than small batches.
In mathematical terms: The training time of one batch gets divided by `batchSize^0.1`.
tooltip: Advance to Persian Town Phase, unlocking new buildings, units, and technologies. Civic Centers gain 20% territory influence radius, +5 population capacity, +5 garrison capacity, +10 attack range, and +2.5 Hack, Pierce, and Crush Resistance, but deal 2% less Pierce damage. Garrisoned units restore Structures an additional 0.5 capture points per second. Persian Stables train cavalry batches more efficiently.
